challenge.challenge_name: Light My Cells 2: Transmitted Light to Fluorescence Challenge

event.conference: France-BioImaging; submitted to ISBI 2027, acceptance not established

eligibility_review.status_at_cutoff: Participation open or already under way; final outcomes not established in this review
eligibility_review.rationale: A distinct second edition, with validation available before the cutoff; two fluorescence-prediction tasks are one annual unit. Image-to-image synthesis does not meet the text-conditioned generation definition.
eligibility_review.evidence: Organizer announcement dated 24 September 2026 states validation began on 21 September and registration/data access were open. Final evaluation and results were scheduled for December. The platform says submitted to ISBI 2027, which is not evidence of accepted conference affiliation.
eligibility_review.limitation: The rules retain a legacy 2024 publication date and inconsistent external-data clauses. Those clauses are not used to infer current post-challenge access or resource policy. The multi-site acquisition statement supports centers, not acquisition-country counts.

assessment_evidence.scope: Timetables and open phases do not establish assessment execution.

provenance.review_method: Source-linked supplementary documentary review; prior-period start dates checked retrospectively.
